register.labelZh: NAIL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 當某人一直不肯確定日期、時間、價錢或承諾時,可以使用 nail somebody down。；nail something down 可以描述最終確定價錢、計劃、協議或其他重要細節。；nail something up 可以清楚表示告示、海報或標牌如何用釘固定在顯眼的位置。；nail something up 描述實際動作;兩個 nail down 表達則通常與明確答覆、協議和決定有關。
register.summaryEn: Nail somebody down is useful when a person keeps avoiding an exact date, time, price or promise. Nail something down can describe the final stage of deciding a price, plan, agreement or other important detail. Nail something up lets you explain clearly how a notice, poster or sign was fixed in a visible place. Nail something up describes a physical action. The two nail down expressions usually concern firm answers, agreements and decisions.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；在 nail somebody down 中,to 後面的內容說明對方最終確定的日期、時間、價錢或決定。語境清楚時,這部分不一定需要出現。We finally nailed him down.(我們終於令他給出明確答覆。)We finally nailed him down to Friday.(我們終於令他確定星期五。)；使用 him、her、it 或 them 時,請按照以上例子放在正確位置。Useful Sentence Forms 常用句式；我們需要令他確定一個日期。)The team hopes to nail down the final price.(團隊希望敲定最終價錢。)The caretaker plans to nail the notice up.(管理員計劃把告示釘起來。；你可以令她確定一個時間嗎?)We must nail down the details today.(我們今天必須敲定細節。)You should nail the sign up above the door.(你應該把標牌釘在門的上方。；記者令講者給出了明確答覆。)The two sides nailed down an agreement.(雙方敲定了一項協議。)The caretaker nailed up a notice.(管理員釘起了一張告示。；我們正嘗試令他確定一個日子。)They have nailed the final details down.(他們已經敲定最後的細節。)She has nailed the poster up.(她已經把海報釘起來。；協議昨天已經敲定。)The notice was nailed up beside the entrance.(告示已釘在入口旁邊。；(雙方經過兩次會議後敲定了交易。)They nailed him down by asking for one clear answer.(他們要求他給出一個明確答覆,終於令他作出決定。)After two meetings and by asking for one clear answer provide extra information. They are notpart of the phrasal verbs.after two meetings 和 by asking for one clear answer 只是補充時間或方法,並不是片語動詞的一部分。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. In nail somebody down, the words beginning with to explain the exact date, time, price or decision. They are not always necessary when the situation is already clear. When using him, her, it or them, place the word as shown: nail him down nail it down nail it up After “to” Subject + verb + to nail... We need to nail him down to a date. After a modal verb Subject + can / may / must / should + nail... Can you nail her down to a time? As an ordinary verb phrase The reporter nailed the speaker down. In continuous and perfect forms We are trying to nail him down to a day. In passive sentences The agreement was nailed down yesterday. With an optional time or method The two sides nailed down the deal after two meetings.
